fieldValues.title: The declared check registry runs in CI
fieldValues.summary: The 39 always-tier checks declared in scripts/checks.json now run on every pull request, where previously the loop ran only when somebody remembered to run it locally. This is the precondition for agent-merged work: auto-merge on green is meaningless unless green means the declared checks actually ran.
fieldValues.body: Scope is the always tier only. The three pinned-cli checks need the pinned srs binary and stay in Release Drift, which already fetches and checksum-verifies it, so the pinned-binary reasoning keeps exactly one home and the new job stays dependency-free.
